scope: Protocol-neutral external monetary and financial reference registry

references.name: Bitcoin
references.purpose: Provide a canonical Bitcoin reference for compatible protocol settlement implementations.

references.name: Ethereum
references.purpose: Provide a canonical Ethereum reference for compatible protocol settlement implementations.

references.name: Traditional Banking
references.purpose: Provide a protocol-neutral reference category for compatible banking providers and settlement adapters.

invariants: Node Core does not execute monetary settlement.
Node Core does not authorize monetary settlement.
Node Core does not custody protocol funds.
Settlement engines consume references; they do not own external-system versioning.
External reference updates must preserve provenance.
